review_notes: I reviewed all of lines 1–43 and grepped for the uses of boundedQuotientEvaluation in the Localization directory. The file contains one theorem and five instances. Every one is about the specific constructions BoundedQ P, boundedEvaluation X and boundedQuotientEvaluation X. Their proofs are applications of general Mathlib localization lemmas: Localization.functor_additive_iff, commShiftOfLocalization, essSurj_mapArrow and isTriangulated_of_precomp_iso. These are already stated for general Lifting data. I did not find a concrete scalar field, universe choice or structural hypothesis here that a useful weaker formulation would remove. Making these instances generic over arbitrary Lifting data would just re-prove existing Mathlib lemmas. It would also make instance search harder, because the statements would depend on the specific construction. I did not inspect the upstream construction files for more general variants, so there is some uncertainty there.
